card.architecture: S3-DiT single-stream (Qwen3-4B encoder, Flux VAE), distilled
card.summary: 8-step distilled ~6B model with near-base quality and notably STRONG instruction/prompt following -- the best model here for anatomical study (specific poses, body positioning, anatomy/figure work). Strong photorealism and bilingual (EN/ZH) text; runs without CFG.
card.pick_when: Best pick when the prompt specifies particular POSES, body positioning, or ANATOMY -- it follows those instructions most faithfully of the models here. Also a great fast photoreal/general model. No negative-prompt control (cfg 1).

prompt.guidance: Descriptive LLM-style. It follows detailed pose / anatomy / composition instructions well, so be explicit about pose, limb position, and viewpoint. Can include EN/ZH text to render.
prompt.example: Photorealistic portrait of an astronaut relaxing in a neon-lit Tokyo ramen bar at night, steam rising, shallow depth of field, 35mm
prompt.overview: Few-step distilled (~6B): long, detailed natural-language prose, no CFG and no negative prompts; strong photorealism, instruction-following and bilingual EN/ZH text.
prompt.instructions: Use natural-language prose, NOT tags -- it 'works best with long and detailed prompts' (you can draft, then have an LLM enhance). Cover subject, composition, lighting, materials, background. It is a few-step distilled model that does not use classifier-free guidance, so it does NOT use negative prompts at all; set guidance_scale 0.0 and num_inference_steps 9 (8 forward passes). Bilingual EN/ZH; to render literal text, name the exact string wrapped in double quotes. Token limit 512 (raise max_sequence_length to 1024 locally for very long prompts). Do not add meta quality tags like '8K' or 'masterpiece'.
do: Wrap literal on-image text in double quotes
examples: A young Chinese woman in red Hanfu with intricate embroidery, impeccable makeup and a red floral forehead pattern, elaborate high bun with a golden phoenix headdress, holding a round folding fan; soft-lit outdoor night background with a silhouetted tiered pagoda and blurred colorful distant lights, photorealistic
prompt.negative_guidance: Runs without CFG; does not use negative prompts at all.

negative.note: Guidance is 0 (distilled); negatives have no effect.

speed.note: Few-step; fast even with GGUF offload.
speed.measured_note: ~26s for the first image at default settings (1024x1024, 8 steps, cold: includes model load); repeats with the same model are faster.

ui_help.note: Describe what you want in a sentence or two, like you'd tell ChatGPT. More detail usually looks better.
